note: Lexicon used by humanize.py and detect.py, tuned for Design Industries. Replacements are plain Australian English and keep the sentence grammatical. 'spelling' is the American-to-Australian pass, 'corrections' fixes misspellings in either system, 'casing' restores Atlassian's own capitalisation (case-sensitive), 'house' is DI's own banned and preferred phrasing (entries with plural:true also match the plural and keep it), 'archived' is retired DI wording that positioning.md no longer uses, and 'protected' is the list of Atlassian product names and DI terms no pass may touch. Edit freely - it is meant to be DI's.

structures.name: "It's not just X, it's Y"
structures.fix: Say the one thing you actually mean. Delete the setup half.

structures.name: "Not only X but also Y"
structures.fix: Split into two sentences, or drop the weaker half.

structures.name: "It isn't about X. It's about Y."
structures.fix: Lead with Y. The reversal is the tell.

structures.name: One-word rhetorical question line
structures.fix: Answer it inline instead of staging a reveal.

structures.name: "Here's what I learned"
structures.fix: State the lesson. Skip the announcement.

structures.name: Rule-of-three triad
structures.fix: Two items or four. Three is the model's default rhythm.

structures.name: Rocket / fire / bulb / sparkle / dart emoji
structures.fix: One emoji max, and not one of these five.

structures.name: Essay-closer opener
structures.fix: A post does not need a conclusion paragraph.

structures.name: Reflex engagement bait
structures.fix: Ask a question only you could ask, about the specific thing above it.

structures.name: US date format (MM/DD/YYYY)
structures.fix: Write the date the Australian way: 6 October, or 6/10/2026 if it must be numeric.

structures.name: Dig at other partners
structures.fix: DI never criticises other partners, named or not. Say what DI does instead.

structures.name: Unproven trust claim
structures.fix: Name an approved client, or give the number ("40 Australian enterprises"), or cut the line.

structures.name: Staccato fragment triad
structures.fix: Three clipped fragments in a row is the model's rhythm. Write one real sentence.
